_about: ROADMAP v3 candidate cards (P0c). A card moves stage card -> rules_read -> pre_registered -> validated/rejected -> shadow -> promoted. rules.status UNKNOWN means the paper's rule section has not been read yet: no params may be invented, and the card cannot be pre-registered until it is filled from the source. family must match gate.FAMILIES (P0a). trial_budget = the most param sets we will ever run for it; each one is a trial in N.

rules.text: BTC bought at first tradable open, held (bh_net).
Each universe coin bought once at first open, 1/N, never rebalanced (bh_ew_net).

sources.cite: Zarattini, Pagani, Barbon (2025), Catching Crypto Trends, SSRN 5209907

candidates.claim: Sharpe > 1.5, alpha 10.8%/yr vs BTC, net of fees (authors' backtest, top-20 liquid rotation)

rules.read_from: secondary: CXO Advisory summary of the paper, quoted in github.com/zebadee2kk/DeFi-TraderStack-Agent/issues/137; lookbacks and 25% target confirmed by the Concretum/QuantifiedStrategies summaries. Primary PDF blocked (SSRN 403): owner may download to confirm.

published.entry: daily close above the max close over the lookback opens that lookback's position
published.exit: trailing stop = max(prior stop, channel midpoint); close when the close falls below it
published.aggregation: equal-weight the open positions across the 9 lookbacks
published.sizing: 25% annualised volatility target using 90-day realised volatility
published.universe: top 20 most liquid; listed >= 1 year; median 30-day daily volume >= $2M
published.fees: 0.10%-0.50% per trade in the paper's net results
published.reported: rotational top-20, Jan 2015 - Mar 2025: CAGR 30%, Sharpe 1.58, alpha +14%/yr vs BTC; BTC alone: Sharpe 1.56, max DD 19%

our_deviations: universe: our REAL_SYMS-style list available in history (15, later 38), filtered by the paper's >= 1 year and $2M median-volume rules; not a full top-20 of all coins (no full-market data)
spot only, leverage capped at 1.0 (vol target can only scale DOWN)
costs: our measured spread model, not the paper's flat fee
channel midpoint = (max close + min close)/2 over the same lookback (the summary does not say highs/lows)

rules.read_from: primary: Fieberg et al. (2025) JFQA, open access CC-BY, sections III.A-C and V.B (read 2026-09-27)

published.indicators_28: rsi(14), stochK(14), stochD(3 of stochK), stochRSI(14), cci; SMA 3/5/10/20/50/100/200 of close scaled by close; macd (EMA12-EMA26 as % of fast EMA) and macd - EMA9(macd); SMA 3/5/10/20/50/100/200 of dollar volume scaled by current volume; volmacd and volmacd - signal; chaikin money flow; Bollinger low/mid/high (20d, 2 sd) scaled by close; Bollinger width
published.preprocess: each indicator -> cross-sectional rank mapped to [-0.5, 0.5]; returns truncated at 0.5/99.5 pct
published.model: univariate Fama-MacBeth regressions per indicator, coefficients averaged over a rolling 52-week window; forecasts combined by elastic net (L1/L2 mix 0.5, strength by corrected AIC) with weights constrained > 0; CTREND = mean of the selected univariate forecasts; regressions value-weighted
published.portfolio: weekly; quintiles on CTREND; value-weighted; long top minus short bottom
published.universe: Coinmarketcap, market cap >= $1M, Apr 2015 - May 2022, 3,245 coins
published.costs: 30 bp long leg, 40 bp short leg per trade; survives, also in big and liquid coins

our_deviations: universe 15-38 Binance coins, not ~3,000: a cross-section this small is a much weaker test
long-only top quintile (no shorting on spot)
equal weights instead of value weights: we have no market-cap history (Binance klines have none); declared, not hidden
Binance data instead of Coinmarketcap; costs from our measured spread model
